tasks.title: Project Setup & Database Schema Implementation
tasks.description: Set up the development environment and implement the database schema according to the ERD in the PRD.
tasks.details:
1. Initialize a new project repository with appropriate structure
2. Configure development environment with necessary dependencies
3. Set up PostgreSQL database with the following entities as specified in the ERD:
   - USUARIOS (users)
   - OBRAS (construction sites)
   - PEDIDOS (orders)
   - FORNECEDORES (suppliers)
   - SCORES (supplier scores)
   - ORCAMENTOS (quotations)
   - PAGAMENTOS (payments)
4. Implement relationships between entities
5. Set up Redis for caching and Bull MQ for queue system
6. Configure CI/CD pipeline with code quality checks (>80% coverage, <10 cyclomatic complexity, <3% duplication)
7. Implement database migrations system

Database schema should strictly follow the ERD with proper data types, constraints, and indexes.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for database models and relationships
2. Integration tests for database operations
3. Validation of schema against ERD specifications
4. Performance testing of common queries (<100ms p90)
5. Verify backup and restore functionality
6. Test database migrations
7. Validate Redis cache integration

# CI/CD Implementation Plan for Turborepo Monorepo

## GitHub Actions Workflow Configuration

Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with the following structure:

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, feature/*]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, feature/*]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Cache Turborepo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm ci

  lint:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Restore Turborepo cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Run linting
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npx turbo run lint -- --max-warnings=0
      
      - name: Run security audit
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm audit

  typecheck:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Restore Turborepo cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Run type checking
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npx turbo run type-check

  build:
    needs: [lint, typecheck]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Restore Turborepo cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Build packages
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npx turbo run build

  test:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Restore Turborepo cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-turbo-
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Run tests with coverage
        working-directory: ./bmad
        run: npx turbo run test -- --coverage
      
      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-reports
          path: |
            **/coverage/lcov.info
            **/coverage/lcov-report
          retention-days: 7
      
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: **/junit.xml
          retention-days: 7
```
</info added on 2025-09-03T17:54:50.067Z>

6. Create supplier selection module that interfaces with the scoring algorithm
7. Implement follow-up scheduling system for T+2h, T+3h, T+4h
8. Set up comprehensive logging for all actions

Pseudo-code for message processing:
```python
class Laura01AAgent:
    def process_material_request(self, message, sender):
        # Validate authorization
        if not self.is_authorized(sender):
            return self.unauthorized_response()
            
        # Parse material specifications
        materials = self.parse_materials(message.text)
        if not materials:
            return self.invalid_format_response()
            
        # Generate unique ID
        construction_site = self.get_user_construction_site(sender)
        request_id = self.generate_id(construction_site)
        
        # Select suppliers
        suppliers = self.select_optimal_suppliers(materials, construction_site, 3)
        
        # Send quotation requests
        for supplier in suppliers:
            self.send_quotation_request(supplier, materials, request_id)
            
        # Schedule follow-ups
        self.schedule_followups(request_id, suppliers)
        
        # Log actions
        self.log_request_processing(request_id, materials, suppliers)
        
        return self.confirmation_response(request_id)
```

Implement the algorithm as specified:
```python
def calculate_supplier_score(supplier_id):
    # Get supplier data from database
    supplier_data = get_supplier_data(supplier_id)
    
    # Calculate individual component scores
    response_time_score = calculate_response_time_score(supplier_data)
    acceptance_rate_score = calculate_acceptance_rate_score(supplier_data)
    delivery_performance_score = calculate_delivery_performance_score(supplier_data)
    price_competitiveness_score = calculate_price_competitiveness_score(supplier_data)
    quality_rating_score = calculate_quality_rating_score(supplier_data)
    
    # Apply weights
    weighted_score = (
        response_time_score * 0.30 +
        acceptance_rate_score * 0.25 +
        delivery_performance_score * 0.20 +
        price_competitiveness_score * 0.15 +
        quality_rating_score * 0.10
    )
    
    # Determine category
    category = 'D'  # Default
    if weighted_score >= 90:
        category = 'A'
    elif weighted_score >= 70:
        category = 'B'
    elif weighted_score >= 50:
        category = 'C'
    
    # Store score in database
    store_supplier_score(supplier_id, {
        'response_time_score': response_time_score,
        'acceptance_rate_score': acceptance_rate_score,
        'delivery_performance_score': delivery_performance_score,
        'price_competitiveness_score': price_competitiveness_score,
        'quality_rating_score': quality_rating_score,
        'total_score': weighted_score,
        'category': category,
        'calculated_at': current_timestamp()
    })
    
    return {
        'score': weighted_score,
        'category': category,
        'components': {
            'response_time': response_time_score,
            'acceptance_rate': acceptance_rate_score,
            'delivery_performance': delivery_performance_score,
            'price_competitiveness': price_competitiveness_score,
            'quality_rating': quality_rating_score
        }
    }
```
